description: HNaZnP₂O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one H and six O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.53 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.76 Å. Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted ZnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one ZnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.39 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-59°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.62 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent ZnO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-51°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. H is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.09 Å) and one longer (1.35 Å) H-O bond length. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Zn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one P, and one H atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Zn, one P, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom.
